facts.fact: The transitional legislative assembly examined and adopted the bill on unique electronic identification of the natural person on 11 October 2024; the article does not mention promulgation.
facts.system: Law on unique electronic identification of the natural person (2024)

facts.fact: The article says the adopted law underpins a system giving each resident a random unique identifier, issued against biographic and biometric data (fingerprints and iris), and linked to the CNIB, passport, driving licence, patient file and bank account.
facts.system: Law on unique electronic identification of the natural person (2024)
